dogecoin.text: Word of mouth. Shiba has this in common with $DOGE and all the other coins with funny names. They seem like a friendly investment, and millions of people invest in these coins “for the meme”. My friends bought it solely because of the "trust me bro" Rationale.

As we all know $SHIB flipped $DOGE. I would argue that this is bad for $BTC. Why? It destroys the thesis of the “Lindy Effect”. Over time, people don’t have brand loyalty if the brand doesn’t perform to their expectations- wether its a fundamental performance or price action.
$MATIC is at $2. $KDA is up 20% today. $DOGE is going to keep running. What a week.
